overview_description.description: Silkroad Audio is the region’s freshest provider of exclusive, high fidelity Middle Eastern stock audio. Their extensive library comprises of regionally relevant audio themes, vocals & sound effects, composed & produced by a creative team of business savvy musicians, including Arabic pop-jazz artist Aziz Maraka. Silkroad Audio also specializes in writing & composing tailored music pieces that meet the specific needs of corporate brands & filmmakers.
